demos.name: JEV Decision Model LAB
demos.description: System One vs System Two for agent decisions: a keyword filter and a (simulated) decision model judge the same prompt-injection, intent-routing and step-up-risk inputs, then a live threshold slider flips the same score between Allow, Step-up and Deny. Mock only; the model is a deterministic feature scorer, not an LLM, and makes no claim about any product.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7550). Mock only: no tenant, no credentials, no LLM API. Docker: HOST_PORT=7550 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). composeFile is relative to the demo root (the folder above this checkout).
